arxiv-2103-09197.title: Maximal entanglement increase with single-photon subtraction
arxiv-2103-09197.creator: Kun Zhang, Jietai Jing, Nicolas Treps, Mattia Walschaers
arxiv-2103-09197.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kun Zhang, Jietai Jing, Nicolas Treps, Mattia Walschaers. Entanglement is an indispensable quantum resource for quantum information technology. In continuous-variable quantum optics, photon subtraction can increase the entanglement between Gaussian states of light, but for mixed states the extent of this entanglement increase is poorly understood. In this work, we use an entanglement measure based the Rényi-2 entropy to prove that single-photon subtraction increases bipartite entanglement by no more than log ⁡ 2 \log 2 .

arxiv-2108-09796.title: Simplicity, bounded normal generation, and automatic continuity of groups of unitaries
arxiv-2108-09796.creator: Abhinav Chand, Leonel Robert
arxiv-2108-09796.description: Abstract . We show that the commutator subgroup of the group of unitaries connected to the identity in a simple unital C*-algebra is simple modulo its center. We then go on to investigate the role of “regularity properties” in the structure of the special unitary group of a C*-algebra.

arxiv-2301-01889.title: FPGA Implementation of SIMON-128 Cryptographic Algorithm Using Artix-7
arxiv-2301-01889.creator: Ridha Ghayoula 1,2 , Jaouhar Fattahi 3 , Amor Smida 4 , Issam El Gmati 5 , Emil Pricop 6 and Marwa Ziadia 3
arxiv-2301-01889.description: Abstract FPGA is a hardware architecture based on a matrix of programmable and configurable logic circuits thanks to which a large number of functionalities inside the device can be modified using a hardware description language. These functionalities must often be secured especially when the context is sensitive (military, banking, medical, legal, etc.).

arxiv-2303-13048.title: Quantum Dot Source-Drain Transport Response at Microwave Frequencies
arxiv-2303-13048.creator: Harald Havir, Subhomoy Haldar, Waqar Khan, Sebastian Lehmann, Kimberly A. Dick, Claes Thelander, Peter Samuelsson, Ville F. Maisi
arxiv-2303-13048.description: Abstract Quantum dots are frequently used as charge sensitive devices in low temperature experiments to probe electric charge in mesoscopic conductors where the current running through the quantum dot is modulated by the nearby charge environment. Recent experiments have been operating these detectors using reflectometry measurements up to GHz frequencies rather than probing the low frequency current through the dot.

arxiv-2309-16467.title: Compositional Program Generation for Few-Shot Systematic Generalization
arxiv-2309-16467.creator: Tim Klinger, Luke Liu, Soham Dan, Maxwell Crouse, Parikshit Ram, Alex Gray
arxiv-2309-16467.description: Abstract Compositional generalization is a key ability of humans that enables us to learn new concepts from only a handful examples. Neural machine learning models, including the now ubiquitous Transformers, struggle to generalize in this way, and typically require thousands of examples of a concept during training in order to generalize meaningfully.

arxiv-2312-06325.title: Representations of Toroidal and Full toroidal Lie algebras over polynomial algebras Thanks: ⋆ Corresponding author
arxiv-2312-06325.creator: Santanu Tantubay, Priyanshu Chakraborty
arxiv-2312-06325.description: Abstract . Toroidal Lie algebras are n n variable generalizations of affine Kac-Moody Lie algebras. Full toroidal Lie algebra is the semidirect product of derived Lie algebra of toroidal Lie algebra and Witt algebra, also it can be thought of n n -variable generalization of Affine-Virasoro algebras.

arxiv-2502-15395.title: Beyond Tools: Understanding How Heavy Users Integrate LLMs into Everyday Tasks and Decision-Making Conference: Tools for Thought: Research and Design for Understanding, Protecting, and Augmenting Human Cognition with Generative AI on CHI 2025 Workshop; April 26,2025; Yokohama, JAPAN ISBN: 978-1-4503
arxiv-2502-15395.creator: Eunhye Kim, Kiroong Choe, Minju Yoo, Sadat Shams Chowdhury, Jinwook Seo
arxiv-2502-15395.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Eunhye Kim, Kiroong Choe, Minju Yoo, Sadat Shams Chowdhury, Jinwook Seo. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for both everyday and specialized tasks. While HCI research focuses on domain-specific applications, little is known about how heavy users integrate LLMs into everyday decision-making. Through qualitative interviews with heavy LLM users (n=7) who employ these systems for both intuitive and analytical thinking tasks, our findings show that participants use LLMs for social validation, self-regulation, and interpersonal guidance, seeking to build self-confidence and optimize cognitive resources.

arxiv-2511-02636.title: Adaptive Quantum Matter: Variational Organization through Ising Agents
arxiv-2511-02636.creator: Lakshya Nagpal, S. R. Hassan
arxiv-2511-02636.description: Abstract The study introduces the Adaptive Quantum Ising Agents (AQIA) framework, a Hamiltonian-based methodology that extends programmable quantum matter into an adaptive domain. Each agent operates as a finite transverse-field Ising subsystem, maintaining internal quantum coherence while interacting through state-dependent feedback channels characterized by reduced observables, such as spin polarization, bond correlation, and internal energy.

pmc-11314360.title: Causal relationship between inflammatory skin diseases and immunoglobulin A nephropathy: A Mendelian randomization and enrichment analysis study
pmc-11314360.creator: Chundi Li, Baisen Wang, Tianrun Han, Ying Xu, Xinhong Li
pmc-11314360.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveTo investigate the causal relationship between inflammatory skin diseases (atopic dermatitis, and psoriasis) and IgA nephropathy using Mendelian randomization and enrichment analysis.MethodsThe instrumental variables (IVs) in the European Bioinformatics Institute (EBI) database were used for two‐sample MR analysis. The results of inverse variance weighting (IVW) were used as the main method, the MR−Egger method was used for pleiotropy analysis and the leave‐one‐out method was used for sensitivity analysis to verify the reliability of the data.

pmc-11494017.title: Assessment of toxicity changes induced by exposure of human cells to lunar dust simulant
pmc-11494017.creator: Jintao Wang, Ming Lei, Yuan Xue, Qi Tan, Xinxing He, Jian Guan, Wei Song, Honglei Ma, Bin Wu, Xinguang Cui
pmc-11494017.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The toxicity of lunar dust (LD) to astronauts' health has been confirmed in the Apollo missions and subsequent biological experiments. Therefore, it is crucial to understand the biological toxicity of lunar dust for future human missions to the Moon. In this study, we exposed human lung epithelial cells (BEAS-2B) and peripheral blood B lymphocytes (AHH-1) to varying concentrations (0, 500, 1000, and 1500 μg/ml) of a lunar dust simulant (LDS) called CLDS-i for 24 and 48 h.

pmc-12612047.title: A composite motif in calcimembrin/C16orf74 dictates multimeric dephosphorylation by calcineurin
pmc-12612047.creator: Devin A Bradburn, Joana C Reis, RYvette Moreno, Shariq Qayyum, Thibault Viennet, Haribabu Arthanari, Martha S Cyert
pmc-12612047.description: Calcineurin, the Ca2+/calmodulin-activated protein phosphatase, recognizes substrates and regulators via short linear motifs, PxIxIT and LxVP, which dock to distinct sites on calcineurin to determine enzyme distribution and catalysis, respectively. Calcimembrin/C16orf74 (CLMB), an intrinsically disordered microprotein whose expression correlates with poor cancer outcomes, targets calcineurin to membranes where it may promote oncogenesis by shaping calcineurin signaling.

pmc-12735551.title: Compositional Effects on Chemical Ordering, Local Atomic Pressure and Thermal Stability in Truncated Octahedral Pd-Ir-Rh Trimetallic Nanoalloys
pmc-12735551.creator: Tuğba Göcen, Kenji Kaneko
pmc-12735551.description: This study presents a comprehensive atomistic investigation of the structural, mechanical, and thermal properties of Pd60IrnRh19−n trimetallic nanoclusters adopting a truncated octahedral geometry. The compositional evolution of chemical ordering, local pressure distributions, and melting behavior was systematically analyzed using Gupta potential-based basin-hopping global optimization.
